structural.title: Delete this submission?
structural.message: “maria@bellacucina.com” is a visitor's own message to you. Deleting removes it from the server for good — no copy is kept anywhere and it can't be recovered. Export CSV first if you might need it.
structural.why: UX-I-34 (Critical) — an irreversible delete of a third party's data sat one click deep, at the same visual weight as the reversible 'mark read' / 'mark spam' beside it. Copy is verbatim from FormsScreen.tsx:413-420, also shipped during this pass.
structural.provenance: carried from plans/settings-confirms.json; straight double quotes replaced with typographic ones — a straight quote inside the sandbox template collapses and kills the payload (RUNBOOK, measured 2026-09-07).

structural.title: Remove this domain?
structural.message: bellastudio.com stops pointing at this site. Visitors following that address get nothing until you reconnect it or change your DNS; the site keeps serving on its buildrick.app address.
structural.why: UX-I-35 (Major) — Domains is the one Settings delete that asks, and it asks with the browser's native window.confirm (DomainsScreen.tsx:154), which the editor cannot style and which reads as a page-level alert. Drawn in the SAME chrome ConfirmDialog shape as the other two so 'delete' means one thing across the tab instead of five.
